brief.text: View-parameterized base class for all ledger entries.

content.text: clauses, providing compile-time guarantees that read-only entries cannot mutate state.

Read-only entries are copyable, movable, and assignable. Writable entries are move-only (not copyable or copy-assignable): the view is stored as a pointer so assignment can overwrite it, but a writable entry's shared_ptr<SLE> is meant to have a single writer at a time.
Derived classes should provide domain-specific accessors that hide implementation details of the underlying ledger entry format.
